+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: The gated eval time limit of 20 minutes was never measured — both gated evals now exceed it
+---
+Found by the gated real-model run of `FM_ROUTER_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 swift test` against `aff8b1b`, recorded on `^z6xdyqn`.
+
+Both gated eval suites stopped on their time limit:
+
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterEvals/CompactionEvaluationTests.swift:421` — "Time limit was exceeded: 1200.000 seconds"
+- `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterEvals/CompactionContinuityEvaluationTests.swift:249` — "Time limit was exceeded: 1200.000 seconds"
+
+The metric assertions that follow each timeout are downstream of it. The run was cut off, so the means cover an incomplete sample set.
+
+## The limit was set by analogy, not by measurement
+
+`Tests/FoundationModelsRouterEvals/Support/GatedEvalSerialGate.swift` holds `gatedEvalSuiteTimeLimitMinutes = 20`. Commit `70ca94b` (2026-08-10) introduced it, and `git log -S` shows it is the only commit that ever touched the value.
+
+The card for that commit, `.kanban/tasks/01KZGD2YCZSRZ826FDX86FFF75.md`, records that the value came from `CompactionRoundTripIntegrationTests` by analogy. Its Tests checkbox is marked NOT RUN. So the limit was never checked against a real eval.
+
+## No valid baseline exists
+
+The only recorded eval durations are in `.kanban/tasks/01KZDA7Q3M8RV2T5W9XCE4HB6N.md`: "evals 299.8s + 511.4s". That run measured commit `159aada` (2026-08-07). Four later commits changed what the evals do, and all four are older than the `7e0c7c5..aff8b1b` batch:
+
+| commit | date | change |
+|---|---|---|
+| `bda41be` | 08-08 | continuity filler text grown, because the dataset was too small to reach the trigger |
+| `dd91e56` | 08-09 | compaction eval dataset and default prompt changed |
+| `70ca94b` | 08-10 | the 20-minute limit added |
+| `aa7f689` | 08-13 | model swapped to `mlx-community/Muse-Glimmer-30B-4bit`, which always reasons |
+
+So no run at the current dataset size against the current model has ever been timed. The 299.8 s and 511.4 s figures cannot be compared with this run.
+
+## Measured shortfall
+
+`CompactionEvalDataset.swift` holds 24 seeds. The run printed 19 seed rows before the limit stopped it. That gives 63.2 s for each sample, and about 1516 s to finish all 24. The suite overran by roughly 26 percent.
+
+`CompactionContinuityDataset.swift` holds 10 tasks. Each task drives many turns through a full `RoutedSession`, so its budget for each turn is far tighter. `foldOccurred` measured `0.2` and `answersCorrect` measured `0.0`. The log prints no per-sample table for this eval, so how many of the 10 completed is not known from the log.
+
+## The batch did not cause this
+
+The evals run their samples one at a time, so a change that lowers generation concurrency cannot slow them. `ResidentModelGates` holds `AsyncSemaphore(value: 1)` for generation, and the value was 1 before `244b1ac` as well. `CompactionEvalRealSubjectRunner` answers through `container.makeSession(transcript: folded)`, which returns the raw backend and no `RoutedSession`, so the changed session layer is not on that eval's path at all.
+
+## Work
+
+Two separate things make the evals slow, and they must not be confused. One is that every turn now writes a `<think>` block. The other is that the summaries come back empty, so no fold shortens the later turns. The empty summary is `^bgxtdk3`, and it must be fixed first — a correct fold may change these timings.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `^bgxtdk3` is closed first, so the timing is measured against a working fold
+- [ ] Both gated evals are timed end to end, and the measured duration is written on this card
+- [ ] `gatedEvalSuiteTimeLimitMinutes` is set from that measurement, with headroom, and its doc comment states the measurement instead of an analogy
+- [ ] The comment on `gatedEvalSuiteTimeLimitMinutes` keeps its stated purpose — to bound a hung real-model load — and the new value still serves it
+- [ ] `FM_ROUTER_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 swift test` reports no time-limit issue from either eval suite
\ No newline at end of file
